name: multi-agent-debate
context: Decisions or analyses where a single generation risks bias or hallucination: multiple agents argue distinct positions across rounds while a judge synthesizes the final verdict.
anti_patterns: Agents with similar capabilities converging on same bias
Same model instance for all agents (no diversity)
best_practices: Use two to three agents over two to three rounds
Use diversity pruning to reduce influence of similar responses (prevents majority tyranny)
Apply misconception refutation to directly counter shared errors
Adjust agent agreement level tuning for faster convergence
references: Du et al., Improving Factuality and Reasoning in Language Models through Multiagent Debate, 2023 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.14325
Smit et al., Should we be going MAD? A Look at Multi-Agent Debate Strategies for LLMs, 2024 — https://proceedings.mlr.press/v235/smit24a.html
MultiAgent Collaboration Attack: Investigating Adversarial Attacks in LLM Collaborations via Debate (arxiv:2406.14711)
